classification: Exploratory public real-speech positive-control for the committed bounded ASCII-Latin phonetic evidence producer only.
disclaimer: Exploratory mechanism positive-control only; this package is not product validation, an effectiveness claim, or a general ASR claim.

excluded_heavyweight_artifacts.reason: Full 1.38 GB FLEURS audio archive is heavyweight; official pinned URL, byte size, SHA-256, and hashes of all 15 included selected WAV members are sufficient for source binding.
Whisper model is heavyweight and redistributability is outside this package; ASR configuration records model identity, bytes, and SHA-256.
Intermediate Cargo products and dependency caches are not required; the exact executable, its SHA-256/size, binary provenance record, and repository HEAD bind the executable used.

excluded_heavyweight_artifacts.item: external Python virtual environment and caches
excluded_heavyweight_artifacts.reason: Environment/cache trees are not study evidence; ASR package version, model hash, inference configuration, raw ASR manifest, and selected WAV hashes are included.
